newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev/mark spread widens at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev/mark spread widens at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 997-1,000 per mark, in a wider spread from 999-1,000 at the opening and 998-999 at Tuesday's close, as demand for marks from local banks and clients eased in the afternoon.

* Demand for marks was also boosted in the morning by foreign investors, which converted lev proceeds from sales of Bulgarian government securities on the secondary market or from treasury paper maturities.

* The lev eased to 1,839-1,842 per dollar from 1,837-1,839 at the opening and 1,825-1,829 at Tuesday's close in line with a mark fall abroad as traders adjusted the lev/dollar to the lev/mark and the mark/dollar cross on global markets.
* The lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark as an anchor in an IMF-prescribed currency board system, which is a fixed exchange rate mechanism introduced on July 1 to restore confidence in the lev.

* Under the system Bulgaria's central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of the anchor currency at a fixed bid of 995 levs and ask of 1,000 against the mark. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
